tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The rates quoted by the tenderer should be inclusive of all taxes(except for generator item rate to be quoted exclusive of GST).
For detailed specification refer to attached detailed estimation.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other documents as per tender document
Firm Registered Proprietor, Partnership, Public Sector or Private limited Company registration certificate
Minimum financial turnover with UDIN not less than the estimated cost of this tender,from the annual payments for any 1 year in last 5 financial years.

Tenderer in his name should have provided at least one similar service to an extent of Rs.13.00 lakhs in any state level dasara event in any one of last five financial years, certificate should be signed by Executive Engineer or equivalent authority.
Tenderer in his name should have turnover in last 5 financial years period i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26 with UDIN number.
